# Input for //bazel/helm:upstream_template_test_opts_selftest. Not a BUILD file:
# nothing loads it. One call passes the option; the guard must name every other.

helm_template_test(
    name = "passes_it",
    chart = ":chart",
    opts = [
        "--set",
        "controller.webhook.spire=true",
    ],
)

helm_template_test(
    name = "no_opts",
    chart = ":chart",
)

# The text of the option, quotes and comma included, in a comment.
helm_template_test(
    name = "only_in_a_comment",
    chart = ":chart",
    opts = [
        "--set",
        "edge.enabled=true",
        # "--set",
        # "controller.webhook.spire=true",
    ],
)

# ...before the list...
helm_template_test(
    name = "comment_before_opts",
    chart = ":chart",
    # "--set",
    "controller.webhook.spire=true",
    opts = [
        "--set",
        "edge.enabled=true",
    ],
)

# ...and as an element of another attribute.
helm_template_test(
    name = "in_another_attribute",
    chart = ":chart",
    opts = [
        "--set",
        "edge.enabled=true",
    ],
    template_patterns = {
        "chart/templates/a.yaml": [
            "--set",
            "controller.webhook.spire=true",
        ],
    },
)

# An element of opts, but not the value of a --set.
helm_template_test(
    name = "after_another_flag",
    chart = ":chart",
    opts = [
        "--set-string",
        "controller.webhook.spire=true",
    ],
)

helm_template_test(
    name = "set_of_something_else",
    chart = ":chart",
    opts = [
        "--set",
        "edge.enabled=true",
        "controller.webhook.spire=true",
    ],
)
